senses.gloss:
शम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be appeased, to be kept
quiet, &c.; (आ), f. a wooden stick or post (as quiet-
ing or making firm); a staff; the pin of a yoke;
a kind of cymbal or other musical instrument held
in the right hand (= ताल-विशेष); a sacrificial
vessel.
—शम्या-पात, अस्, m. the cast of a stick, i. e.
the distance that a stick can be thrown.
—शम्या-
मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. having the measure of a
Śamyā, as large as the pin of a yoke.

साम्य साम्य, अम्, n. (fr. 1. सम), even-
ness, equality, parity, sameness, equipoise; likeness,
similarity; harmony; equability; impartiality, indif-
ference.
—साम्य-ता, f. or साम्य-त्व, अम्, n.
equality, sameness.
—साम्य-बोधक, अस्, इका, अम्,
expressive of similarity.
—साम्यावस्था (˚य-अव्˚),
f. equal state, equipoise.

शाम्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, becoming calm or tranquil,
being appeased; one who is placid or quiet.

सम्म्यक्ष् सम्-म्यक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -म्यक्षति,
&c. (see rt. म्यक्ष्), Ved. to be held together or
united; to be joined with.

सम्यञ्च् सम्य्-अञ्च् or सम्य्-अच्, अङ्, ईची, अक्
(fr. an old loc. 2. समि + अञ्च्, see समि; cf.
तिरि fr. तिरस् in तिर्य्-अञ्च्), going along with or
together, going with, accompanying; uniform, same,
identical; all, entire, whole, complete; correct, accu-
rate, proper, true, right; pleasant, agreeable; (अक्),
ind. at the same time, with, together; wholly, com-
pletely, entirely, comprehensively, thoroughly, fully,
accurately, correctly, truly, properly, fitly, in right
manner, honourably; well, duly; distinctly, clearly.
—सम्यक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to make true, perform well.
—सम्यक्-चारित्र,
अम्, n. ‘correct conduct,’ one of the three excellent
things (according to the Jainas, see रत्न-त्रय).
—सम्यक्-त्व, अम्, n. completeness, correctness, ac-
curacy, propriety, (क्षायिक-स्˚, that state of perfection
in which material existence is destroyed.)
—सम्यक्-
पाठ, अस्, m. correct recitation or pronunciation.
—सम्यक्-प्रयोग, अस्, m. fitting or proper use
or employment, due practice; (एण), ind. by the
use of proper means.
—सम्यक्-प्रवृत्ति, इस्, f.
the right or proper direction (of the organs).
—सम्-
यग्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, properly or accurately said, of
equal weight or authority.
—सम्यग्-गमन, अम्,
n. the act of going with, accompanying.
—सम्यग्-
गोप्तृ, ता, m. a true protector or guardian.
—सम्-
यग्-ज्ञान, अम्, n. ‘complete knowledge,’ one of
the three jewels or excellent things (according to
the Jainas, see रत्न-त्रय).
—सम्यग्-दण्डन,
अम्, n. the act of punishing properly or justly;
punishing legally.
—सम्यग्-दर्शन, अम्, n. ‘com-
plete vision, accurate perception,’ one of the three
jewels or excellent things (according to the Jainas,
see रत्न-त्रय); (with अव्रत), epithet of the
fourth of the fourteen stages leading to final emanci-
pation (according to the belief of the Jainas).
—सम्-
यग्-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, continuing in the proper
discharge of duty, &c.
—सम्यग्-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
[]
properly conducted; wholly confiding in.
—सम्यग्-
वृत्ति, इस्, f. steady or complete practice, regular
discharge of prescribed duties.
